import.geometry_policy: original source archives are preserved; Quaternius runtime tree buffers clamp only finite float COLOR_0 values in (1, 1.0002] to 1; oak LOD0 joins the 36 source parts while preserving positions and UVs exactly and normals within the conversion proof; maple preserves supplied large_3 LOD1 topology and bakes only its source transform; LandscapeLab Quercus and Pine preserve supplied GLBs byte-for-byte, with source-grounded bounds and 1 m normalization metadata; Poly Haven fern and flower derivatives preserve selected source mesh primitives and binary geometry while removing only gallery transforms
import.lod_policy: Godot 4.7.2 ResourceImporterScene automatic mesh LODs enabled for glTF assets; the oak source contributes LOD0 only, with supplier LOD1/LOD2 excluded; Wavefront OBJ assets use supplied geometry
import.shared_material_policy: original Quaternius glTF materials and textures are preserved; the oak legacy M_Quercus material maps its packed atlas to Principled BSDF base color with roughness 1.0 and BLEND alpha, as recorded in the conversion proof; Godot 4.7.2 imports metallic_specular at its native 0.5 default; OBJ/MTL diffuse materials are preserved; shared source files are extracted once; maple uses the source bark/leaf PBR maps with masked double-sided foliage; its conversion manifest records channel mapping; LandscapeLab materials and embedded textures are preserved byte-for-byte, including their source MASK foliage conventions; understory textures preserve supplier maps; fern MASK 0.5 is retained and Flower Empodium BLEND is staged as MASK 0.5 with alpha packing recorded

buffer_derivation.method: Clamp finite float COLOR_0 components above 1 and at or below 1.0002 to 1; reject negative, non-finite, over-limit, or unsupported color accessors.
